ei.title: The Power of Perspective in Storytelling
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Whose story it is affects what the story is. Change the main character, and the focus of the story must also change. If we look at the events through another character's eyes, we will interpret them differently. We'll place our sympathies with someone new. When the conflict arises that is the heart of the story, we will be praying for a different outcome. Consider, for example, how the tale of Cinderella would shift if told from the viewpoint of an evil stepsister. Gone with the Wind is Scarlett O'Hara's story, but what if we were shown the same events from the viewpoint of Rhett Butler or Melanie Wilkes?

When the conflict arises that is the heart of the story, we will be praying for a different outcome. Consider, for example, how the tale of Cinderella ③<u>would</u> shift if told from the viewpoint of an evil stepsister. Gone with the Wind is Scarlett O'Hara's story, but what if we were ④<u>shown</u> the same events from the viewpoint of Rhett Butler or Melanie Wilkes?

det.korean: ① affect → affects: 명사절 주어는 단수 취급
det.analysis:
✅ ① affects: 'Whose story it is affect what the story is' — 원문은 affects. 명사절 주어(Whose story it is)는 단수 취급하므로 affects가 맞음. affect는 오류 ← 정답

❌ ② interpret: 'we will interpret' — will + 원형, 정상

❌ ③ would: 'the tale ... would shift' — 가정법 조동사, 정상

❌ ④ shown: 'we were shown' — 수동태 과거분사, 정상
det.tip: 명사절 주어 = 단수 → affects

When the conflict arises that is the heart of the story, we will be praying for a different outcome. Consider, for example, how the tale of Cinderella would shift if told __________. Gone with the Wind is Scarlett O'Hara's story, but what if we were shown the same events from the viewpoint of Rhett Butler or Melanie Wilkes?
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

사악한 의붓자매의 관점에서

[조건] (1) an, evil, from, of, stepsister, the, viewpoint를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: from the viewpoint of an evil stepsister
det.analysis:
본문: 'if told from the viewpoint of an evil stepsister' — 전치사구(from the viewpoint of) + 명사구(an evil stepsister).
[조건 검증] from(1) the(2) viewpoint(3) of(4) an(5) evil(6) stepsister(7) = 7단어 ✅
det.tip: from the viewpoint of ~ = ~의 관점에서

questions.wa: from the viewpoint of an evil stepsister
accept: from the viewpoint of an evil stepsister

questions.passage: If we look at the events through another character's eyes, we will __________ (interpretation) them differently. We'll place our sympathies with someone new. When the conflict arises that is the heart of the story, we will be praying for a different outcome.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: interpret (해석하다)
det.analysis: will 뒤 동사원형 자리이므로 명사 interpretation의 동사형 interpret가 필요
det.tip: 명사 → 동사: interpretation → interpret

det.korean: we will be praying for a different outcome

[조건 검증] we(1) will(2) be(3) praying(4) for(5) a(6) different(7) outcome(8) = 8단어 ✅
